why: The text ("While this unit is within 3" of a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit, this unit has Lone Operative") names no phase. Approved lists store no timing ({}) for every always-on defensive ability whose text names no phase: Da Grand Warlord’s Ladz, Lord of Murder and Mechanicus Bodyguard (Lone Operative while within 3"), Kustom Force Field (InSv), Augury Uplink and Flowing Flesh (Feel No Pain), Unyielding Ancient (lite-knights), the Kastelan Repulsor Grid ("When an enemy unit targets this unit with ranged attacks") and the Scarab Occult save ability ("each time an attack targets this unit"). derive.js offers [Move your / Shoot opp / Fight] for all of them, and every one was left {}. The owner's rule labels an ability with "the phases and turns its text names", and this text names none. Its "When targeted" line (def) or stat column already shows it. The attack-side always-on abilities (Spiteful Power Trip, Even More Dakka) are the ones that carry attack phases. The def "Lone Operative while within 3"…" already shows it as a When-targeted line. The exact text also appears on Da Grand Warlord’s Ladz, which is stored {}.

PSYKER is one model's keyword, not the combined unit's. Wahapedia's Wardens of Ultramar prints "KEYWORDS – ALL MODELS: INFANTRY; EPIC HERO; EXPLOSIVES; IMPERIUM; TACTICUS / Dainal Komelius: PSYKER" (waha-words.js already reads this as modelKeywords). The approved convention for a keyword only some models have is kwOnly, with the keyword left out of the "come from" note. The Rubric Marines and Scarab Occult units carry `kwOnly:{ Psyker:… }` and their kwNote does not name Psyker. So the unit also needs kwOnly:{ Psyker:'Dainal Kornelius' }, and Psyker stays in kw. Explosives and Tacticus are on every Warden and Bladeguard model and not on Calgar (Calgar: INFANTRY; CHAPTER MASTER; CHARACTER; EPIC HERO; IMPERIUM; TERMINATOR), so they rightly come from the combined unit.

fix.kwNote: Explosives, Tacticus, Wardens of Ultramar, Bladeguard Veteran Squad come from the combined unit.
